scene: The popped bubble rains glowing sugar, uncovering three loading bays.
picture: Flat side view. Left of centre, the South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair wipes sparkling sugar dust off her teal hoodie. On the far left, a yellow delivery truck idles. In the centre, an open glass elevator tube glows. On the far right, a striped airship bobs at a ramp.
shown: A yellow delivery truck sits idling at an open loading door on the far left.
A transparent glass elevator tube stands with glowing open doors in the centre.
A striped passenger airship floats tied to an outdoor mooring ramp on the far right.

variants.scene: Sparkles shower down over the docks as three different rides wait for you.
Golden sparkles drift past the sleepy orange lizard as three exits open up.
Sweet sugar dust twinkles down, lighting up three fantastic ways to keep travelling.
